name: empty_object_row_leading
description: An all-object array with a non-empty field union MUST use tabular form even when a member object is empty; the empty row's absent field is emitted as ~ (Section 7.3, 7.4.2). Only an array of exclusively empty objects uses expanded form (containers/006). Regression guard: an empty leading object must not disqualify the array from tabular encoding.
